extract: Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde is an 1886 Gothic novella by the Scottish writer Robert Louis Stevenson. A London lawyer, Gabriel John Utterson, looks into the strange bond between his old friend Dr Henry Jekyll and the brutal Edward Hyde, and finds that the two men are one.
